item.title: Space your coffee plants about 6 to 8 feet apart to allow enough room for growth
item.description: Spacing coffee plants at the appropriate distance is crucial for their healthy growth and optimal yields. The recommended spacing for coffee plants can vary based on several factors, including the coffee variety, local conditions, and your specific farming practices.
